product_one_liner.value: A personalized financial education and wellbeing platform for employers to help employees make better financial and benefits decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage says the platform gives every employee a personalized financial education experience; the company describes delivering financial-wellbeing programs for organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer lists no pricing link, and the pricing URL returns a page-not-found message, supporting a negative answer.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Meta client story discusses Meta using nudge, and the Siemens case study says Siemens chose nudge. | named_customers.0: The Meta client story names Meta. | named_customers.1: The Siemens case study names Siemens.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 116 employees, which falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Global HQ address is in London, United Kingdom. | hq_country: The company’s Global HQ address is in London, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The company history says, “In 2013, that idea became nudge,” supporting 2013 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows marketing and workplace-financial-wellbeing categories and posts; the reviewed index did not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links to an FAQ but its navigation/footer does not show a public product documentation site, developer portal, or multi-article help center; the observed help resource is the FAQ page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open jobs list shows a Strategic Account Executive and a Senior Software Engineer, with no AI-, ML-, or data-science-titled role.

model_provider.notes: The FAQ describes the AI money coach as powered by AI, and the Trust Center lists subprocessors and infrastructure, but the reviewed FAQ, AI launch material, and trust information do not name an AI model or model provider. The answer is unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The information-security page names ISO 27001 and says nudge operates in line with GDPR; the Trust Center confirms ISO/IEC 27001 certification. GDPR is included because the requested list explicitly includes it. ISO/IEC 42001 is not included because it is outside the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: The information-security page names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.1: The information-security page says nudge has operated in line with GDPR since early 2017.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Dealroom identifies the March 2021 Kennet Partners round as Series A. | funding_date: The funding profile gives March 1, 2021, and Dealroom reports the Kennet Partners Series A in March 2021; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2021-03. | funding_amount_usd: A-Leads reports the Series A amount as $6,964,448; Dealroom independently identifies the March 2021 Kennet Partners Series A as £5.0m. The amount is reported in dollars by A-Leads, though sources differ in how they express the amount and currency.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified outside funding round is the March 2021 Series A, which predates the 18-month window before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open jobs list includes a Strategic Account Executive role and its job page provides an application link, supporting current account-executive hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced personalized financial action plans on September 1, 2026, a product feature launch within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated announcement reports that nudge appointed Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as U.S. Vice Presidents on October 15, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed sales job posting discusses marketing campaigns, SDR support, and prospecting but names no CRM or sales/marketing system. Teamtailor is identified on the page as an applicant-tracking system, not one of the requested systems.
